sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A columnar cactus from Ecuador and Peru, often placed in Trichocereus as T. pachanoi. Its upright stems usually have six to eight ribs and can reach several metres.

sections.title: Flowering and fruit
sections.text: Large white flowers open at night. The plant later produces fleshy fruit. It is related to Echinopsis macrogona, but identification requires comparing ribs, spines and flowers.

sections.title: Caution
sections.text: Mescaline has been measured in stem tissue; concentrations vary, and these data do not establish food use. Do not consume it.
